title: Secure App
summary: Hardcoded credential inside an APK. Recovered by static analysis — no device, no root, no runtime.

title: Rooted or not?
summary: XOR-encoded flag behind a client-side root check. The decryption algorithm is fully visible in smali.

title: Loaded Dice
summary: On-chain lottery with predictable randomness. Winner reconstructed offline from block fields.

title: The Vault That Ate Itself
summary: Textbook reentrancy in withdraw(). Recursive drain in a single transaction, flag derived from the function selector.

title: Echo Signature
summary: ECDSA signature malleability enabling replay. First Blood — flag derived from the malleated signature hash.

title: Oracle
summary: CBC padding oracle attack against a silent binary. Full plaintext recovered byte-by-byte from exit codes alone.

title: Securebank
summary: SQLi -> client-trusted JWT -> SSTI in EJS. Three bugs chained into full remote code execution.

title: Cleartext Catch
summary: FTP credentials and a backup file recovered from a PCAP. Carved from a raw TCP stream and unlocked with the reused password.

title: No See Code
summary: Zero-width Unicode steganography inside a password-protected zip. Two-channel payload decoded byte-by-byte.
